scripts.text:
[Langry]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Fabres?
scripts.translation:
[蘭格里]
你打完50只綠棉蟲了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放棄

scripts.text:
[Langry]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet...
scripts.translation:
[蘭格里]
嗯，我覺得你還沒打夠50只...

scripts.text:
[Langry]
Remember, I need help hunting Fabres so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[蘭格里]
記住，我需要你幫忙打綠棉蟲，所以去打50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Langry]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[蘭格里]
你確定要停止狩獵嗎？
你目前的進度將會被清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Langry]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[蘭格里]
好吧，如果你改變主意了，隨時回來找我。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[蘭格里]
請擊殺50只綠棉蟲。

scripts.text:
[Langry]
Amazing, you did that with speed.
scripts.translation:
[蘭格里]
真厲害，你完成得真快。

scripts.text:
[Langry]
I need to collect ^0000CE25 Fluff^000000 to
complete this community service project.
You know what? I can even reward you a little for helping me.
scripts.translation:
[蘭格里]
我需要收集^0000CE25個絨毛^000000來完成這個社群服務專案。
你知道嗎？我甚至可以給你一點報酬作為感謝。

scripts.text: I have some Fluff
scripts.translation: 我有絨毛

scripts.text: What was that again?
scripts.translation: 剛才說什麼來著？

scripts.text:
[Langry]
Thank you for the Fluff. This helps me out greatly.
Oh and here you go, this should help you get stronger, faster!
scripts.translation:
[蘭格里]
謝謝你提供的絨毛，這幫了我大忙。
哦，給你這個，應該能讓你變得更強、更快！

scripts.text:
[Langry]
I see no Fluff, wait yea I do it's the lies coming from your mouth.
scripts.translation:
[蘭格里]
我沒看到絨毛，等等，我看到了，那是從你嘴裡冒出來的謊言。

scripts.text:
[Langry]
I need ^00CE0025 Fluff^000000.

[Langry]
Ah, ok I think you can help me out by hunting some Fabres.
How many would you like to hunt?
scripts.translation:
[蘭格里]
啊，好吧，我想你可以幫我抓一些綠棉蟲。
你想抓多少隻？

scripts.text: 50 Fabres
scripts.translation: 50只綠棉蟲

scripts.text: 100 Fabres
scripts.translation: 100只綠棉蟲

scripts.text: 150 Fabres
scripts.translation: 150只綠棉蟲

scripts.text:
[Langry]
Hello, my name is Langry.
I have to complete this community service, but I am just too lazy.
scripts.translation:
[蘭格里]
你好，我叫蘭格里。
我必須完成這個社群服務，但我實在太懶了。

scripts.text:
[Langry]
You may just be the most unlikely person ever, recycle a few Fabres and come back.
scripts.translation:
[蘭格里]
你恐怕是最幫不上忙的人了，先去回收幾隻綠棉蟲再回來吧。
